source.property: MUL_MAT source batch3 equality mandatory before dispatch
p021 special case requires both permuted + one column + source batch3 both1 + device workgroup limits
noncontiguous matvec has stride/permutation and device limits
general vector: dst.ne1==1 OR small columns and source1.ne2*ne3==1
matmul split_k depends on runtime device/pipeline, not inferred here
passes mask ne2/ne3 and nb1/2/3; frozen shader bytes lack individual manifest binding
softmax source contiguous F32, optional mask F32/F16
CONT/CPY/DUP F32 source and destination supported
GQA and fourth-axis broadcast use contiguous repetition division
F16 vector-dot type, CPU may convert F32 source1; llamafile fast path separately reachable
mask column i01; mask heads i02%ne12; batch i03%ne13
view source retained; descriptors alias owner, cont/concat allocate results
q1 original delegate; q2 PQ slices or QB batch lift
Q/K/V permutations; no flash/bias/sinks/softcap/alibi admitted; optional V transpose+cont
context-owned role:phase:layout:ub:capacity key; sync and invalidate on change
reuse requires equal n_tokens, sequences, output and parameter identity; q1/q2 cannot reuse same topology
